| Source Field | Senzing Attribute | Transformation | Notes |

| billing_id | RECORD_ID (root) | none | stable unique key; not a feature |
| (constant) | DATA_SOURCE = BILLING_SYSTEM (root) | constant | |

Only the parts present are written; a feature with no part present is omitted.

## Mapping Decisions

- One PERSON master keyed by `billing_id`; second billing accounts stay separate records for Senzing to resolve.
- `plan` and `last_invoice_date` follow the Bootcamper's CRM_SYSTEM decisions for a category column (payload) and a date column (ignored).
- The source file is the regenerated one (same records, narrower gaps) from the return to Data collection; formats were normalized in Phase 1 Step 7a.
